claims.text: RASi-associated hyperK: often manage by ↓K rather than ↓dose or stopping the RASi.
claims.quote: Hyperkalemia associated with use of RASi can often be managed by measures to reduce the serum potassium levels rather than decreasing the dose or stopping RASi

claims.text: Mild hyperK: sodium polystyrene sulfonate, patiromer or sodium zirconium cyclosilicate.
claims.quote: For mild hyperkalemia, sodium polystyrene sulfonate, patiromer, or sodium zirconium cyclosilicate

claims.text: Patiromer: ⍉emergency tx for life-threatening hyperK (delayed onset).
claims.quote: Veltassa should not be used as an emergency treatment for life-threatening hyperkalemia because of its delayed onset of action
